newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo firms on mark, seen holding gains.
newsitem.headline: Escudo firms on mark, seen holding gains.

text.p: The escudo continued to edge higher against the mark on Wednesday in thin trade and traders expected the trend to continue.
The currency was trading at 100.95/98 to the mark, against its 100.98/101.03 Tuesday close, with traders seeing a range for the day of between 100.85 and 101.00.
Traders said that the currency was supported by the approaching privatisation of EDP Electricidade de Portugal and the summer tourist season.

But the currency remained vulnerable to any international instability triggered by the political situation in France where voters return to the polls on Sunday for a second round balloting in parliamentary elections.
